# dsh-selection-actions

A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin: select any fragment of a
conversation and turn it into a citation
in the message you are about to send — or open it in a parallel chat.
English | Русский
## What it does
1. **Selection toolbar.** Select text in the conversation and a small toolbar appears next to the se

lection:
`Add to chat` and `Add in side chat`.
2. **Add to chat** stages the fragment in the current

composer. The draft shows a compact
`N conversation selections` strip with a remove control; hoveri

ng it slides out the staged citations.
When you send, each fragment becomes a blockquote in the prom

pt — the model reads it as quoted context.
3. **Sent citations render as cards.** The transcript rep

laces the raw `> …` block with a card
(quote glyph, excerpt, “Quote from the conversation”), so neit

her you nor the model sees a wall of markdown.
4. **Add in side chat** forks the current Session, op

ens the copy in the right Sidebar as a parallel chat and
stages the same citation there, so follow-u
p questions do not pollute the main thread.
## Install
The plugin is a bundle: the Host half is empty, everything lives in the Web client. Install it with

the
harness plugin manager, from this checkout or straight from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then reload the Web GUI page. It is a per-profile installation and survives restarts.
### Install from the plugin market (no npm account, one URL)

The repository ships a format-1 market index, so the plugin installs from a pinned commit
without np
m. Add this URL under **Settings → Plugins → Discover → index sources**:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The version it lists installs as
`git+https://github.com/ccclosed/dsh-selection-actions.git#<commit>
`, so an install is always reproducible.
## How it works

- `client.js` — the whole plugin (Web client half, `window.__ModuleLoader__` module):
- `shell.overl

ay` — the floating toolbar next to a selection;
- `conversation.input.dock` — the citation strip abo

ve the composer card;
- `conversation.input.overlay` / host slots — not used; the strip lives in the

dock seat because that
seat renders reliably while the in-card overlay seat deactivated the entry;
- `ctx.inputTriggers.registerSource` — a reference source whose `codec.serialize` turns a chip into

.text.node` — the transcript card renderer.
- `index.js` — empty Host half (`apply() {}`), so there

is no Config and no Host-side settings.
- `locale/en.json`, `locale/ru.json` — only `meta` (title an

d description for the plugins list). Button
labels, counter forms and tooltips are registered by `cl
ient.js` itself for both languages.
## Known limitations
- The citation strip is attached to the composer card from the dock seat (see above) and overlaps it

s top
edge by a few pixels rather than being a child of the card.
- The remove control clears this p

lugin’s citations only when the draft holds no foreign reference chips.
- `Add in side chat` reuses

the shipped `subagentchat` Sidebar tab, so the tab title falls back to the fork’s
Session id when th
e Session has no projected title yet.
## License
MIT — see LICENSE.
## Русский
Плагин для веб-GUI DeepSeek Harness: выделяешь фрагмент переписки и превращаешь его в цитату в отпра

вляемом
сообщении либо открываешь его в параллельном чате.

- **Add to chat** — фрагмент попадает в композер текущего чата. Над полем появляется плашка
`N conve

rsation selections`: по наведению из неё выезжают добавленные цитаты, крестик убирает их.
При отправ

ке каждый фрагмент становится блокквотом в запросе — модель читает его как цитируемый контекст.
- **

Отправленная цитата рисуется карточкой** (кавычка, фрагмент, подпись «Цитата из переписки»), а не
сы

рым `> …` текстом.
- **Add in side chat** — форк текущей сессии открывается отдельной вкладкой в пра

вой панели, туда же
подставляется цитата; основная ветка не засоряется.
Установка: `dsh plugin --profile <профиль> add /путь/к/dsh-selection-actions`, затем перезагрузить с

траницу.
Host-половина пустая, настроек нет; вся логика в `client.js`.
